blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — A knife was confiscated from a student at Marbel 7 National High School here Tuesday morning as schools tightened security following a city-wide safety assessment, triggered by last Friday’s shooting in nearby Banga town that left three students dead and six others wounded. The discovery came as classes resumed after the city government suspended classes at all levels in public and private schools on Monday to allow safety and security assessments on campuses across Koronadal.
